newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EMV SHARE ISSUE APPROVED - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: EMV SHARE ISSUE APPROVED - REPORT.

text.p: Share holders of EMV, one of the largest construction companies in Estonia, approved a proposal to organise a share issue worth 23.7 million kroons, the Aripaev business newspaper said on Monday.
The bonus issue wil double the equity capital of the company to 47.4 million kroons.
The meeting on Saturday also approved a board proposal to pay 15 kroons dividend on each 100 kroon share, the newspaper added.
The company will also appoint Aavo Kokk, a board member of Hoiupank , to the company's board, the paper said.
EMV turnover for 1996 was 350 million kroons and its profit was 16 million kroons. The company has forcast a turnover of 420 million kroons in 1997 and a profit of 20 million kroons.
